title: Implementability in Insurance Markets with Adverse Selection
abstract: arXiv:2609.31959v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider an insurance market with hidden information, where the agent's type is private information and is drawn from an arbitrary type space. We study implementability of a collection of retention functions, namely, how to select premium schedules so that the resulting menu of contracts is incentive compatible, or truthful. Specifically, for general type spaces, implementability is equivalent to cyclical monotonicity of the collection of retention functions. For compact interval type spaces, we show that submodularity is a sufficient condition for implementability, under suitable type ordering assumptions. Moreover, for any implementable collection of retention functions, we characterize all corresponding premium schedules, up to a common additive constant. translated_title: 逆向选择保险市场中的可实施性
translated_abstract: 我们研究一个存在隐藏信息的保险市场，其中代理人的类型是私人信息，且取自一个任意的类型空间。我们研究一组留存函数的可实施性，即如何选择保费方案，使得由此产生的合同菜单具有激励相容性（即真实性）。具体而言，对于一般类型空间，可实施性等价于留存函数组的循环单调性。对于紧区间类型空间，我们证明在适当的类型排序假设下，次模性是可实施性的充分条件。此外，对于任何可实施的留存函数组，我们在相差一个共同加性常数的意义下刻画了所有对应的保费方案。最后，我们将结果应用于几类标准的保险合同，对于这些合同，一般性的可实施性条件可以化为更简单的刻画，并且我们……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文研究逆向选择保险市场中合同菜单的可实施性，证明了一般类型空间下可实施性等价于留存函数组的循环单调性、紧区间类型空间下次模性是充分条件，并在相差一个共同常数的意义下完整刻画了所有对应的保费方案。
en_tdlr: This paper studies implementability in insurance markets with adverse selection, proving that implementability is equivalent to cyclical monotonicity of retention functions for general type spaces, that submodularity suffices for compact interval type spaces, and characterizing all corresponding premium schedules up to a common additive constant.
